Connecting the Stripe Payment Gateway

You can accept card payments for membership plans by connecting Stripe.

Steps

  1. Open Settings > Payment Gateways.
  2. Select Stripe and paste your publishable key and secret key.
  3. Switch Test Mode off when you are ready to take live payments.

Only one card gateway can be active at a time.
